name: runner-log
title: RunnerLog
description: The runner's log of a test run: a small heading with a live or completed status, and a scrolling role="log" of time, level and message lines.

a11y.pattern: <section> named by its heading; the body is role="log" (implicit polite live region), focusable so keyboard users can scroll it
keyboard: Scroll the log when it has focus
aria: role="log" announces new lines politely without moving focus
Every level is written (INFO, SEND, PASS, FAIL, WAIT); colour only speeds up scanning
The status (live · streaming, N lines · completed) is written text
